files.author: Seth Anderson
files.evidence: Green fascia reads 'TOWN ALE HOUSE EST.1958' over the entrance; no street number in frame. Tie to 777736 is by name plus the brief's note (Old Town Ale House at 219 W North). Name match only.

frames.material: painted wood sash and transom frames

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 004.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Door glass reads '152' followed by a last digit that is obscured by a sticker and blur (enlarged and sharpened; still not legible). Street not visible. Four-storey (entry level plus three) red brick, cream stone lintel and sill bands, bracketed cornice, raised entry with stone-faced stoop. Possibly a 152x address such as 782163 (1520 N Wieland), not confirmed. Recent daylight frame; the only full-facade shot in the set of this type. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Old_Town_Chicago_February_2026_004.jpg

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 002.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Black awning reads '1505' (confirmed in an enlarged crop). Four-storey red brick with cream stone hoods over the upper windows and a cream band at the parapet, iron stoop railings. Street not visible. 1505 is not on the list; if on the Wieland odd side it would sit between 783964 (1503) and 783442 (1507).

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 001.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Three-storey red brick with a dark painted cornice and black-painted band, arched-top upper windows with dark painted hoods, storefront sign 'CORCORAN'S GRILL' (pub). Address not shown; not matched.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 003.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Buff/orange brick front, three storeys, with a copper-green painted metal bay oriel and dark wood storefront. Address not shown.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 007.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Corner building with cream and pink-red painted trim on a bay and cornice, buff brick side wall, slate-faced bay roof. Address not shown.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 008.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Cream/buff stone or terracotta front with Gothic arched entries, red brick piers with black bases and carved roundels. Not matched; a reference for Old Town arch-entry detailing only.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 009.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Three-storey red brick, dark cornice with stepped brackets, arched upper windows, cream stone sills. Address not shown.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Old Town Chicago February 2026 010.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Curved-glass bay windows on a red-brown brick front, three storeys, with a parapet. Address not shown.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Town Shop MADGE Wells Street Old Town Chicago, Ill. June 1965.tif
unidentified_but_relevant.what: 1965 photo. Dark brick front with the number 1561 on the facade, a striped canvas awning 'Town Shop' and a 'MADGE' storefront to the right. 1563 N Wells (777645) may be an adjacent parcel; not confirmed. Not a current view.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:North Wells Street, Chicago, May 1985; photographer, Jeff Wassmann.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: 1985 street scene: Wells St storefronts with a painted mural on a yellow-brick ground floor, stoop steps and iron rail; no address. Context for the street, not a list facade.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Second City. Old Town, Chicago.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Second City entrance, Wells St: pale stone arch with a carved bust and a 'The Second City' sign. Not on the list; stone-arch detailing near Wells.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Thin building in Old Town, Chicago 2015-86.jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Tapering tan/yellow brick corner building, four storeys, deep hip cornice, with a 'BRICKS CHICAGO' sign. Address not shown.

unidentified_but_relevant.title: File:Badly faded loading zone sign (26478188459).jpg
unidentified_but_relevant.what: Geotagged 83 m from the lot. Street-level frame of a dark grey-brown common-brick front with a tall party wall and round window, behind a green awning with valet-parking lettering and a script name (best reading 'Pippin's', low confidence). Adjacent fenced demolition lot with a 'Heneghan Wrecking Co' sign, so the frontage has since changed. Street number not visible; not matched to a list id.
